====== @Inject ======

===== Effects & Use-Cases =====
''@Inject'' injects a call to the handler at the chosen point; it can also return early by [[#cancelling|cancelling]].
See ''[[https://github.com/LlamaLad7/MixinExtras/wiki/WrapOperation|@WrapOperation]]'' for wrapping single calls.

==== Cancelling the target method ====
FIXME //This section needs an example.//
Set ''cancellable = true'' and call ''cancel()'' on the ''CallbackInfo''.\\
<code java>
@Inject(method = "tick", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
private void skipTick(CallbackInfo ci) {
    ci.cancel();
}
</code>
